claims.scope: battleElo rating update in EloCalculator using Elo.ratingChange change and negative flag

preconditions.text: battleElo calls Elo.ratingChange to obtain a rating change amount change and a direction flag negative for one party after a single battle.; When negative is true, Elo.ratingChange(eloB, eloA, ...) signifies that eloB's rating should decrease.; When negative is false, eloB's rating should increase.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The rating update must move each party's Elo in the direction indicated by the negative flag: a decreasing party loses change and the opposing party gains change, so better-performing parties are not decreased and worse-performing parties are not increased.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Protocol functionality relying on the calculated Elo ratings operates on entirely incorrect data, causing distorted rankings, unfair matchmaking and mismatched rewards.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: battleElo is the only consumer of Elo.ratingChange within the described flow and applies the returned change and negative to eloA and eloB.
The negative=true and negative=false branches are mutually exclusive alternatives; the plan covers the general requirement rather than one observed battle.
Dependent protocol functionality (rankings, matchmaking, rewards) reads the Elo ratings produced by this update path.
